reason: I'd run the free check on our supply-shop group out of curiosity, and maybe use the 40 free documents, but I wouldn't pay $19 every month for it. A café is maybe 30-60 nota a month, and I can have someone type them into Excel or KasKecil for nothing.
objection: It's another monthly subscription for something I can do myself for free. Unless the free check finds my staff padding nota, I can't see it earning back $19 every month.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check found real money lost, like duplicate or padded nota from the building-supply shop worth more than a few months of the fee, I'd pay at least for a month.
